rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for the act or process of taking something apart, especially for analysis.

example.english: The decomposition process in this experiment is quite interesting.
example.traditional: 呢個實驗嘅拆解過程幾有趣。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 ge3 caak3 gaai2 gwo3 cing4 gei2 jau5 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this for the biological process in which organic material breaks down into compost or simpler substances.
Use this as a technical noun for a matrix, atom, or compound splitting into constituent parts.

example.english: The decomposition of this compound produces two substances.
example.traditional: 呢個化合物嘅分解會產生兩種物質。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 faa3 hap6 mat6 ge3 fan1 gaai2 wui5 caan2 sang1 loeng5 zung2 mat6 zat1
